identity.name: OpenMM 8.2.0 DHFR pme fixed-work ensemble on one GPU
identity.brief_workload: Eight seeded DHFR replicas, sequential baseline versus concurrent execution with MPS.
identity.provenance: Public executable pme benchmark and inputs verified; fixed-work adaptation is inline in supplied brief, not independently published code at a public URL.

outcome_definition.primary: Minimize total wall seconds for complete fixed ensemble; speedup = sequential_total_wall_s / candidate_total_wall_s.
outcome_definition.scientific_acceptance: Brief predicts identical per-seed energy series on same hardware/software with deterministic forces. Fallback refers to measured sequential run-to-run variation, which is unavailable. No independent published energy acceptance tolerance exists.
outcome_definition.energy_tolerance_reason: No published numeric acceptance criterion; do not use integrator constraint tolerance as outcome tolerance.
outcome_definition.published_performance_acceptance_reason: NVIDIA observations are fixed-time reference throughput, not acceptance thresholds for fixed-work ensemble. Brief speedup ranges are predictions.
outcome_definition.reference_comparison: Report context and units; do not score fixed-work runtime against approximate fixed-time throughput reference.

repeatability.requirements: Same GPU model, OpenMM pin, force fields, initial positions, precision and deterministic-force setting for comparisons.
repeatability.reason: No repeat count or statistical aggregation rule published for supplied fixed-work driver.
repeatability.determinism_status: Unverified on CUDA. Documentation describes deterministic forces but also cautions single-precision PME simulation determinism depends on settings; trajectory identity requires reproduction.

outcome_definition.interface_limitation: Inline driver samples energies internally but serializes only mean and final value; complete time-series equality cannot be audited from ensemble.json alone.

citations.description: Supplied fixed-work ensemble specification and inline sequential driver; predictions are hypotheses, not published results.
Public executable pme benchmark; fixed-time throughput measurement, not fixed-work ensemble.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock image identity, Python version, architecture, glibc, NVIDIA driver and MPS availability were not supplied or inspected; no CUDA reproduction performed.
provisional_compatibility_evidence: OpenMM 8.2.0 publishes manylinux x86_64 wheels for CPython 3.10 through 3.13.
OpenMM-CUDA-12 8.2.0 publishes manylinux_2_27/2_28 x86_64 plugin wheel and declares NVIDIA CUDA 12 runtime, nvcc, NVRTC, CUPTI and cuFFT dependencies.
Brief requires one CUDA-12-compatible NVIDIA GPU; NVIDIA post demonstrates OpenMM 8.2.0 with MPS on H100-class hardware.
stock_cuda_image.mps_permission_reason: Host daemon availability and permission were not supplied.

data_and_memory.reason: PDB plus two XML file sizes verified over HTTPS; peak host/GPU memory for eight concurrent contexts and CUDA runtime is unpublished and unmeasured. Installation footprint not included in input bytes.

discovery: No benchmark search or replacement; inspected only brief-linked sources and their pinned raw files/PyPI metadata.
